build_auto_quantization_config: build an AutoQuantizationConfig from a dictionary containing a quant_method key
create_auto_hf_quantizer: create an AutoHfQuantizer instance from a QuantizationConfig or dictionary
test_get_hf_quantizer: test get_hf_quantizer to instantiate and validate a quantizer for a model config
